How to Play
  • 🏀
    Tap the ball to score taps and earn points
  • 🌳
    Buy Skills to multiply every tap you make
  • ⚡
    Hold the ball to charge a power shot at the hoop
  • ⚙️
    Automation — hire auto-tappers that score for you
  • 👑
    Prestige resets your run for permanent multipliers

BasketTap is a free browser basketball clicker — no download, no account needed.
